## Purpose

Project-owned, token-driven visual primitives (`Button`, `Badge`, `Card`, `Pill`, `Tabs`,
`ErrorBoundary`, `CompletionToast`, `NotificationPanel`) that every other component tree (chat,
workflow, preview, results, history, layout, settings, library) builds surfaces out of.

**It is the lowest layer of the frontend's own design system â€” not a wrapper over an external UI
kit.**

## Shape

- [Button.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/Button.tsx), [Badge.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/Badge.tsx), [Card.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/Card.tsx), [Pill.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/Pill.tsx) â€” small stateless primitives: each takes a
  `variant`/`status`-style prop plus native HTML attributes (spread via `...rest`), and composes
  a class string from a `Record<Variant, string>` lookup table. No CSS-in-JS, no
  styled-components â€” just Tailwind utility strings keyed on the shared token layer (`bg-brand`,
  `text-ink-900`, `var(--radius-button)`, `var(--status-running-fill)`, etc).
- [Tabs.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/Tabs.tsx) â€” a controlled `{id,label}[]` underline-tab bar (`active`/`onChange` props); owns no
  state itself.
- [ErrorBoundary.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/ErrorBoundary.tsx) â€” a class component (`getDerivedStateFromError`/`componentDidCatch`) that
  renders a "Something went wrong" fallback with a retry button; the one primitive here that
  isn't purely presentational.
- [CompletionToast.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/CompletionToast.tsx) and [NotificationPanel.tsx](../../frontend/src/components/ui/NotificationPanel.tsx) â€” heavier, stateful composites built on top
  of the plain primitives (`Badge`, `Pill`) plus `motion/react` for enter/exit animation and
  `lucide-react` icons. `NotificationPanel` owns open/close state, an outside-click/Escape
  handler, and merges a `liveRuns` list with terminal `notifications` into one dropdown, reusing
  `Badge`/`Pill` rather than hand-rolled markup.
- Consumes `@/hooks` (e.g. `useNotifications`'s `getWorkflowLabel`) and `@/lib`
  (`parseRunInput`) for label/formatting logic; owns no fetches itself.

## Why this shape

Every primitive is deliberately generic: `Button`'s `variant` and `Badge`'s `status` are
presentational tokens, never workflow or agent names, so **the same five components serve chat,
results, preview, history, and settings without per-caller forks** (the codebase's own
convention, called out inline in each file as "SC-001"/"D-15").

Colors, radii, and spacing route exclusively through CSS custom properties from a shared token
layer ("NO raw hex" is enforced by comment in every file), so a palette change is a token edit,
not a per-component hunt. `Badge`'s `normalizeStatus` always falls back to a safe neutral key
instead of throwing or rendering arbitrary text, keeping unknown/legacy status strings from
breaking the chip.

Composites (`NotificationPanel`) are kept in `ui/` rather than `layout/` because **their content
(icons, chips, motion) is still built purely from other `ui/` primitives** â€” the only escape
hatch into app-specific data is the small formatting helpers imported from `hooks`/`lib`.
